name: Ember Wyrm
flavor: A master of flame and heat, drawn to hoards that burn brightest.

name: Frost Sovereign
flavor: A controller of frost whose patience outlasts glaciers.

name: Granite Warden
flavor: A stalwart defender who counts every stone in the pile.

name: Zephyr Drake
flavor: Swift and restless — no claw taps the hoard faster.

name: Umbral Shade
flavor: Mysterious and cunning, hoarding wealth no one ever sees.

name: Dawn Regent
flavor: A radiant collector — every achievement gleams in its scales.

name: Venom Coil
flavor: A toxic specialist who never lets a relic slip away.

name: Storm Tyrant
flavor: An energetic striker whose fortunes arrive in bursts.

name: Molten Colossus
flavor: A mountain that learned to hoard; the whole brood toils in its shadow.

name: Tempest Roc
flavor: It rides the golden updrafts, snatching every glint before it fades.

name: Ruin Serpent
flavor: Coiled through a hundred plundered tombs, it smells treasure through stone.

name: Astral Leviathan
flavor: It swam between prestiges before the first coin was ever struck.

name: Worldeater Wyrm
flavor: The apex hoarder. Kingdoms, oceans, stars — all of it is simply inventory.

name: Solar Monarch
flavor: Crowned in caught sunlight, it hoards the glints others let slip away.

name: Nightmother
flavor: She has watched a hundred worlds burn and reform, and the brood adores her for it.
